name: Form desk mat
subtitle: A softer landing for long days.
alt: Minimal desk accessories on a warm workspace
details: A generous, tactile surface that brings a little calm to the everyday. Water resistant, easy to wipe clean, and finished with softly rounded corners.

name: Lift laptop stand
subtitle: Bring your screen into focus.
details: A considered lift for your laptop. Six quiet height positions and a stable, open frame keep your screen at a more comfortable angle.

name: Arc desk tray
subtitle: A place for the little things.
alt: Orderly desk with accessories and plant
details: Three small compartments turn loose everyday essentials into a simple still life. Made to sit neatly beside your keyboard.

name: Solis task light
subtitle: A warmer kind of focus.
alt: Sculptural desk light in a calm room
details: A focused pool of warm light with a sculptural, low-profile silhouette. Three touch dimming levels shift naturally from morning to evening.

name: Quiet cable rail
subtitle: Let the cables disappear.
details: A simple under-desk rail that gathers power bricks and trailing cables out of sight. Clamps on in minutes, no drilling required.

name: Orbit headphone hook
subtitle: Good gear, off the desk.
alt: Headphones resting by a computer setup
details: A compact home for headphones between listening sessions. Soft curved edges keep your headband in good shape.
